verdict.rationale: Persona documents a broad API for its core resources: pre-creating inquiries, polling statuses, fetching verification details, running reports, and backend-only verification through the Transactions API. Nothing in the pack claims or shows API parity with the dashboard. Configuration surfaces such as inquiry templates, workflows, Cases and the IP allowlist are described as dashboard features with no API equivalent evidenced. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API management of inquiry templates/workflows/cases, API configuration of security settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Persona API is a powerful tool that enables you to integrate identity verification, risk assessment, and compliance solutions into your applications.
Use the API to pre-create inquiries before directing users through the inquiry flow for information collection and verification.
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
Transactions API | backend-only verification APIs, no Persona UI | Fully custom UI or backend-only verification flows
